en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
While performing Tawaf, say:
"O Allah (swt), I ask You by Your Name through which one walks on the surface of water as they walk on firm ground. I ask You by Your hidden and treasured Name that is with You. I ask You by Your Greatest, Greatest, Greatest Name, which, when called upon, You answer, and when asked through, You give. Bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad and grant me [state your request here]."
When you reach the Yemeni Corner (Rukn al-Yamani), touch it, kiss it, and send blessings upon Prophet Muhammad and his family in every circuit.
